title: Opt-in diagnostic can retain passing acceptance status
severity: S2: test infrastructure could misclassify instrumented evidence; no product defect
preconditions: Source5c0c03d1 opt-in SEO CPU diagnostic classifier before independent finding af91b965.
reproduction: Invoke actual hosted SEO diagnostic classifier with opt-in true and successful status pass.
Inspect classified receipt status and acceptance evidence interpretation.
expected: Every opt-in instrumented outcome is excluded from native acceptance, including pass; default non-diagnostic outcomes retain their own semantics.
actual: Only partial status is changed to diagnostic_only. A pass remains pass and can be accepted by the evidence summarizer even with empty targets.
root_cause: Classifier switches only one successful status rather than enforcing the diagnostic evidence class independently of outcome.

transition_history.reason: Fresh independent actual-classifier probe reproduced pass retaining pass.
Evidence summarizer recognizes pass, violating explicit no-credit invariant.
Fresh implementation lane owns classification and causal guard repair.
Fresh independent peer reproduced prior pass defect and verified actual classifier-to-summary guard22/22. Native diagnostic delivery pending.

closure_requirement: Actual classifier/writer and consumer exclude all diagnostic outcomes, with causal old-red/new-green guard and fresh independent review. Native SEO health stays unverified.
